title: Read the robot pose
description: Read position and orientation from Odometry. Pose is different from the velocity command that made the robot move.
steps: Subscribe in Python. Read position and calculate yaw from quaternion orientation.
Report your calculation with report_pose(x, y, yaw). Try a one-shot Twist in another terminal and observe changes.
hints: Position is msg.pose.pose.position; orientation is msg.pose.pose.orientation.
For planar motion yaw = 2 * atan2(q.z, q.w) also works.
The general yaw expression is atan2(2*(w*z+x*y), 1-2*(y*y+z*z)).

es.title: Leer la pose del robot
es.description: Lee posición y orientación desde Odometry. La pose es distinta del comando de velocidad.
steps: Inspecciona /odom con ros2 topic echo /odom --field pose.pose.
Suscríbete en Python y calcula yaw a partir del cuaternión.
Llama a report_pose(x, y, yaw). Publica un Twist con --once en otro terminal y observa el cambio.
hints: En movimiento plano también sirve yaw = 2 * atan2(q.z, q.w).
